title: Fourier coefficients under coordinate permutation
statement: For every natural number $n$, every permutation $\pi$ of the $n$ coordinates, every real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube, and every coordinate set $S$, the Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the function obtained by permuting the input coordinates according to $\pi$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at the image of $S$ under $\pi^{-1}$.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube
